title: Verify Events listing page displays all existing events with complete details after login
preconditions: User is logged out (or the test begins from the login page)
Valid demo credentials available: email 'manish123@gmail.com', password 'Manish9@@'
At least one event already exists in the system (pre-existing seed data or events created in prior runs)
Browser: Chromium (project default), viewport 1366x768, OS Windows/macOS as available

testSteps.action: Navigate to https://eventhub.rahulshettyacademy.com/ and wait for the login form to be visible
Enter the demo email into the user email input (placeholder 'you@email.com')
Enter the demo password into the password input (placeholder '••••••')
Click the 'Sign In' button and wait for the post-login app shell to render
Click the 'Events' tab in the top navigation (id '#nav-events')
Wait for the Events listing view to load (network idle) and observe the rendered event cards/list rows
Verify that at least one event card/row is visible and inspect the fields displayed on the first event (e.g. title, category, city, venue, date & time, price, total seats, status)
Verify the 'Add New Event' button is present and enabled in the Events view
Verify the URL contains '/events' (or the Events route is active) and the 'Events' tab is the active/selected nav item

expectedResult: The Events listing page renders successfully after login. At least one event is visible with complete details (title, category, city, venue, formatted date & time, price, total seats). The 'Add New Event' button is visible and clickable. The Events tab is the active navigation item, and the URL reflects the Events route.

title: Verify successful creation of a new event via the Add New Event form (happy path)
preconditions: User is already authenticated as 'manish123@gmail.com' (login completed in TC-EVT-001 or equivalent)
User is on the Events listing page (Events tab is active)

testSteps.action: Click the 'Add New Event' button on the Events page to open the creation form/modal
Wait for the 'Add New Event' form to be visible
Enter the event title into the title input (id 'event-title-input')
Select a category from the category dropdown (id 'category') — pick the third option to mirror the existing project step
Enter the city into the city input (id 'city')
Enter the venue into the venue input (id 'venue')
Enter the event date & time into the date/time input (id 'event-date-&-time')
Enter the price into the price input (placeholder '0.00')
Enter the total seats into the total seats input (id 'total-seats')
Click the 'Add Event' submit button (id 'add-event-btn') to submit the form
Wait for the new event to appear in the listing (network idle)
Verify the text '25 Jun 2026' appears exactly once on the page (existing project assertion in src/tests/steps/test.ts step 'user validates Event has been created')

expectedResult: The new event 'Test Event' is created successfully and appears in the Events listing. The formatted date '25 Jun 2026' is visible exactly once on the page (confirming the new event row is rendered with the selected date). The form closes or resets, and the listing reflects the newly added event alongside any pre-existing events.

title: Verify Add New Event form rejects empty/invalid submissions and surfaces validation errors
preconditions: User is already authenticated as 'manish123@gmail.com' (login completed in TC-EVT-001 or equivalent)
User is on the Events listing page and has just opened the 'Add New Event' form

testSteps.action: Click the 'Add New Event' button to open the creation form
Without filling any field, click the 'Add Event' submit button (id 'add-event-btn')

Observe that the form is NOT submitted, no new event row appears, and at least one inline validation error is shown for the required fields (title, category, city, venue, date & time, price, total seats)
Fill the title only and clear it again to whitespace only, then click submit
Observe that whitespace-only title is rejected with a validation message (e.g. 'Title is required' or 'Please enter a valid title')
Enter a valid title and a non-numeric / negative value in the price field, then click submit
Observe that the price field is rejected with a numeric/positive-value validation message and the form does not submit
Enter a valid price but '0' or a negative value in the total seats field, then click submit
Observe that the total seats field is rejected with a 'must be greater than 0' (or similar) validation message
Now fill all fields with valid values from TC-EVT-002 and submit once to confirm the form is not stuck in a permanent error state
testSteps.testData: Title: 'Test Event', Category: index 2, City: 'Test City', Venue: 'Test Venue', Date: '2026-06-30T06:28', Price: '200', Seats: '5'

testSteps.action: Verify the event is created (text '25 Jun 2026' appears) — proving the previous errors were transient validation issues, not a broken form

expectedResult: The Add New Event form validates required fields and rejects empty, whitespace-only, and out-of-range inputs. Inline error messages are displayed for the offending field(s) and the form does not submit until all inputs are valid. Once corrected with valid data, the same form successfully creates the event (confirming the '25 Jun 2026' text appears), proving validation is the gate, not a permanent failure.
